newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia to raise Wang Dan jailing with Beijing.
newsitem.headline: Australia to raise Wang Dan jailing with Beijing.

text.p: Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer on Tuesday said Australia would express its concern to Beijing over the "severe sentence" given to Chinese dissident Wang Dan and the speed of his trial.
"The severe sentence and the speed with which the trial was conducted are obviously cause for serious concern," Downer told parliament.
"We clearly have been concerned about the case and we naturally enough are in the process of expressing those concerns to the government of China in Beijing," he said.
A Beijing court last Wednesday took less than four hours to condemn Wang for plotting against the government and sentenced him to 11 years jail.
Wang's trial and sentencing have sparked expressions of concern from around the world.
The jailing of the 27-year-old dissident was the latest in a series of crushing blows to China's tiny and struggling pro-democracy movement.
Most dissidents have already been forced into exile or are serving long sentences in prison or adminstrative detention.
